projects_compact_hint: No days selected = any day. Set weekly minutes to 0 to turn off the time target.
projects_allocation_covered_help: Includes scheduled Sessions and recorded work. Task completion is tracked separately.
projects_intro: Projects group Tasks around an outcome. Use Milestones for checkpoints along the way.
projects_create_help: Name the outcome you want to work toward. You can add Tasks and optional Milestones after creating the Project.
projects_target_help: Optional: reserve this much time each week for ready Tasks in this Project. Set 0 to leave the target off.
projects_allocation_help: Scheduled Sessions and recorded work count toward this target. Add ready Tasks with effort estimates or adjust your available time to fill the gap.
projects_milestone_help: An optional checkpoint on the way to the Project's outcome. Group the Tasks needed to reach it here.
projects_no_milestones: No Milestones yet. You can work directly with Project Tasks, or add a checkpoint when you need one.
projects_direct_help: Active Tasks that are not assigned to a Milestone.
projects_no_tasks: No active Tasks here yet. Add one, or assign an existing Task from its details.
projects_next: Choose or break down the next Task and add an Effort estimate.

planning_unscheduled_hint: Includes Tasks with remaining unplanned effort. Scheduled time is not progress.
planning_save_failed: Could not save Session. Try again.
planning_measure: Primary progress measure (changing it resets progress)
planning_capacity: {minutes} minutes open. Capacity covers midnight to midnight in your local time. Default Session: 45 minutes.
planning_shortfall: Cannot fit in this Day: {minutes} minutes short.
planning_session_description: Edit the Task and its planned Session.
planning_drag_hint: Click a Task to edit it. Drag it onto the Day to add a Session, or use its menu to schedule automatically.
planning_task_completed: This Task is completed. Its Session remains in the plan.
constraints_window_hint: Windows use local time and follow daylight-saving changes. Split overnight windows at midnight. End 00:00 means the next midnight.
constraints_override_hint: Overrides apply in the listed order. Remove an override to restore the weekly template.
constraints_keep_event: Keep these fixed Event times despite conflicts
constraints_allow_placement: Place this Session despite the shown conflicts
constraints_ambiguous_hint: The clocks go back on this date, so this local time happens twice. Choose the intended UTC offset.
constraints_attention_hint: Focused: reserve this time for the Event. Background: allow other Tasks during the Event.
constraints_default_hint: Your whole day is available by default, every day. Add limits only if you need them.
constraints_protected_hint: Tasks are never placed automatically during Protected periods. Overnight windows such as 22:00–07:00 continue into the next day.
constraints_use_weekly: Limit Tasks to weekly time windows
planning_active_tasks_hint: All active Tasks. Search to find what to plan.
planning_pause_automatic: Pause automatic planning for this Task
planning_automatic_hint: Tasks with estimates are planned over seven days from the selected Day. Removing a Session pauses its Task. Use Schedule automatically or Replan all to resume it. Pins and active work stay protected.
planning_estimate_needed: Add an effort estimate to automatically plan the remaining work.
check_in_worked_hint: Some work done, but the Task is not finished.
check_in_no_common_actions: No shared actions for this selection. Open a Session to edit its report.
check_in_selection_hint: Click to select · Ctrl/Cmd-click to toggle · Shift-click for a range · Enter to open
recurrence_no_end_hint: Repeats until you stop the series.
recurrence_calendar_example: Example: Read every day from 20:00. A new Occurrence arrives each day, even if yesterday was missed.
recurrence_frequency_example: Example: Exercise three times per week. Each workout is a separate Occurrence.
recurrence_volume_example: Example: Read 100 pages per week. Record 30, then 40, then 30 pages across Sessions to complete one weekly Occurrence.
recurrence_completion_example: Example: Clean the coffee machine seven days after you last finished cleaning it. Finishing later shifts the next Occurrence later.
recurrence_carry: Carry unfinished Occurrences forward until done
recurrence_explanation: Each Occurrence tracks its own progress. Missed work expires by default. Local times follow daylight saving; missing times shift forward and repeated times use the earlier instant.
jira_help: Work files are imported only when selected. No Jira connection or external AI processing. Reimports preserve local planning edits and progress. Only supplied issues are updated; missing issues are kept.
jira_file_limit: Use a CSV smaller than 500 KB.
jira_format: Time estimates use minutes; dates use YYYY-MM-DD (end of day UTC). Separate boards with semicolons. Sprint firm flags accept true/false. Remaining time wins; otherwise use 50% of original estimate or the fallback. Story points never become hours.
